items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: I heard him in Sam Morgan's band as a child... I would just hear them as they were battling on the trucks. So I wasn't allowed to go to public dances. So I really don't know.

ctx.x: What was the first band of music that you heard live? Do you remember? What kind of music was it?

Well, we had a lot of records as children, but I can't recall. But then the first band whom I heard as a child was Sam Morgan and Rainey, and at that bunch, they would come over there as a child. And they would barely own trucks around the home. And they would've been lost. I would've been lost. I think that was about the first.

Hey, Sam Morgan, for instance. Remember, did you carry a piano player, did he? I don't think so. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. What was the first band that you saw that was using a piano player?
